summary: The predeclared direct-start competence gate failed: stochastic completion was 0/32 on training seeds, 0/16 on development seeds, and 0/6 on familiar seeds, versus 6/6 qualified warm tail-60 handoffs. Deterministic execution scored 0/27 direct and 3/3 handoff, with 93.8 percent special-no-effect actions during direct play. Direct reports recorded initial boss health 9 versus 1 or 2 at handoff. All 90 scored episodes were controller-valid with zero restarts. Live preparation took 1112.3 seconds. Per protocol, the six optimizer runs were not launched and final-test gameplay remains untouched. Fixed-versus-varied learning is inconclusive; the narrower evidence identifies guide dependence and a repeated-THROW behavior requiring a separate action-semantics diagnostic. No policy selected or promoted.
